note: packages/http-recorder/tsconfig.json (compilerOptions trimmed) as its build script/build.ts compiles it, called by script/pack.ts. opencode's tsc is TypeScript 6 (catalog typescript: npm:@typescript/typescript6@6.0.2) and no package script runs effect-tsgo or effect-language-service, so the @effect/language-service entry never reached a build and `bunx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` exited 0. Setup rewrote it to vibelang, which runs the entry's rules: 200+ unstableApiUsage warnings (EK38130), exit 2, and pack published nothing. Setup now writes the plugin's two exit options into the entry (VIP-38 R3), so the warnings print and the build exits 0.
